action.description: Task actions: create with 'add'; inspect with 'list'/'get'/'runs'/'events'/'status'; change with 'update'; control with 'pause'/'resume'/'cancel'/'run'; delete with 'remove'. Goal-workflow actions: 'goal_add', 'goal_list', 'goal_get', 'goal_pause', 'goal_resume', 'goal_cancel', 'goal_remove'. Step actions within a goal: 'step_add', 'step_list', 'step_get', 'step_retry'.

description.description: Free-text description for 'add' and 'step_add'; also one of the fields 'update' may change.

interval_secs.description: Repeat interval in seconds (recurring only); also one of the fields 'update' may change.

lease_ttl_secs.description: Per-step lease TTL; 0 uses the execution-mode default.

name.description: Name: the task for 'add', the goal for 'goal_add', the step for 'step_add'; also one of the fields 'update' may change.

payload.description: Work to run — prompt for agent_session, command for shell. Required by 'add' and 'step_add'; also one of the fields 'update' may change.

priority.description: Priority (default normal); also one of the fields 'update' may change.

task_id.description: Task ID for 'get'/'runs'/'update'/'run'/'pause'/'resume'/'cancel'/'remove'; the Goal ID when 'events' is called on a goal.
